Convert brma Summaries to a Data Frame

Source: R/summary.R
as.data.frame.brma.Rd

Converts the non-empty tables displayed by a fitted brma object or its summary.brma result to one plain, long-form data frame. The leading component column identifies the summary section and parameter retains the displayed row label. Printed quantile labels are returned as syntactic CI_ column names.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'brma'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'summary.brma'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

a fitted brma or summary.brma object.

row.names

NULL or a character vector giving the row names.

optional

logical; passed to the final data-frame coercion.

stringsAsFactors

accepted for compatibility with data.frame().

...

for a fitted object, additional arguments passed to summary.brma(); otherwise unused.

Value

A plain data.frame containing all displayed summary rows. An object created with only_data = TRUE or only_priors = TRUE has no fitted model to export and stops with an error of class RoBMA_unfitted_object (also of class RoBMA_unsupported_request); summary() shows the data of an only_data object, and the summary of an only_priors object shows the priors in its priors element.
